title.zh: 将南拉瑙省马拉维市的Amai Pakpak总医院改设为医疗中心，名称为Amai Pakpak医疗中心，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Amai Pakpak General Hospital in Marawi City, Lanao Del Sur, Into a Medical Center, to Be Known as the Amai Pakpak Medical Center, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Amai Pakpak General Hospital in Marawi City, Lanao Del Sur, Into a Medical Center, to Be Known as the Amai Pakpak Medical Center, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Bệnh viện Đa khoa Amai Pakpak tại Thành phố Marawi, Tỉnh Lanao Del Sur thành Trung tâm Y tế với tên gọi Amai Pakpak Medical Center, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงพยาบาลทั่วไป Amai Pakpak ในเมือง Marawi จังหวัด Lanao Del Sur เป็น ศูนย์การแพทย์ในชื่อ Amai Pakpak Medical Center และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Rumah Sakit Umum Amai Pakpak di Kota Marawi, Provinsi Lanao Del Sur menjadi Pusat Medis dengan nama Amai Pakpak Medical Center, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Hospital Besar Amai Pakpak di Bandar Marawi, Wilayah Lanao Del Sur kepada Pusat Perubatan dengan nama Amai Pakpak Medical Center, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1995/ra_7943_1995.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Amai Pakpak General Hospital located in Marawi City, Lanao del Sur, is hereby converted into a medical center with all the necessary personnel, equipment and facilities, to be known as the Amai Pakpak Medical Center.
The Department of Health shall formulate the necessary guidelines for the operation of the said medical center.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
